svg.text: bias_dist_pd: switchable distribution mirror, 3 sourced inputs -> 4 sourced outputs (1 : 1), digital enable en_3v3
Enabled inputs (en_in<k> = 1) add up in NI; NM copies the sum into the PMOS diode PD; each enabled output PO<j> sources it through its TG.
iout<j> feeds a bias_tree_pd (NMOS input diode NI behind its own TG), e.g. one per pad; a disabled output's TG is open and PO<j> carries no current.
en_3v3 = 0: all TGs open, TDN pulls ni to vss, SVPD pulls vpd to vdd. Devices as in bias_tree_pd (NI 6u/6u, BP 5u/6u, switches 1u/0.45u). Source: netlist/source/bias_dist_pd.spice
[D] digital: one nand2_hv / inv_hv per input and output (en_out<j> and en_3v3 join the output decode by name). [S] [M] [O] analog: transmission gates, mirror, PMOS outputs.
